OPERATION.OPERATIONALERT-NOTE1: 1）The Octant service can be started in one cluster and manage multiple clusters.
OPERATION.OPERATIONALERT-NOTE2: 2）Prometheus Stack is enabled for all clusters that you want to monitor.
OPERATION.OPERATIONALERT-NOTE3: 3）The Grafana service can be started in a cluster and is automatically connected to the Prometheus Stack of multiple clusters by association.
OPERATION.OPERATIONALERT-NOTE4: 4）Any cluster that wants to collect logs needs to deploy a set of Fluent bits. Automatically connects to the target Logging Stack through the association.
OPERATION.OPERATIONALERT-NOTE5: 5）The Logging Stack service can be started in one cluster to receive logs from multiple clusters.

ADDOPERATION-PAGE1.PAGEALERT: After the service is created, you can edit the association again. There is no strict requirement on the service startup sequence.
ADDOPERATION-PAGE1.OCTANTTIPS: Octant is a tool that lets developers understand how applications run on Kubernetes clusters. It mainly includes cluster navigation, visualization of cluster resources, rendering of Kubernetes object dependencies and so on.
ADDOPERATION-PAGE1.PROMETHEUSTIPS: Prometheus is an open source system monitoring and alarm solution. The suite includes components such as Prometheus, AlertManager, Node Exporter, PushGateway, and Kube-State-Metrics.
ADDOPERATION-PAGE1.GRAFANATIPS: Grafana is an open source visualization and analytics platform that integrates multiple data sources into a single panel, supporting multiple charts and layout presentations.
ADDOPERATION-PAGE1.LOGGINGTIPS: The Logging Stack contains ElasticSearch and Kibana. ElasticSearch is a full-text search and analytics engine for storing, searching, and analyzing massive amounts of data. Kibana is an open source analytics and visualization platform for searching and viewing the data stored in ElasticSearch.
ADDOPERATION-PAGE1.FLUENTBITTIPS: Fluent Bit is an open source logging processor and forwarder that can collect any data from different sources, such as logs, process it with filters and send it to multiple destinations.

ADDPROVIDER-TKGM-PAGE.RESOURCEPOOL-HELP: Set the workload cluster node resource pool. This parameter is equivalent to the VSPHERE_RESOURCE_POOL parameter for creating a workload cluster. If not set, the resource pool parameter of the management cluster will be inherited.
ADDPROVIDER-TKGM-PAGE.VMFOLDER-HELP: Set the workload cluster node vm folder. This parameter is equivalent to the VSPHERE_FOLDER parameter for creating the workload cluster. If not set, the directory parameter of the management cluster will be inherited.
ADDPROVIDER-TKGM-PAGE.DATASTORE-HELP: Set the storage of the workload cluster nodes. This parameter is equivalent to the VSPHERE_DATASTORE parameter for creating the workload cluster. If not set, the storage parameters of the management cluster will be inherited.
ADDPROVIDER-TKGM-PAGE.PARAMS-DESC: Add more cluster configuration parameters with the key name of the variable name to create the cluster file, such as VSPHERE_STORAGE_POLICY_ID. If not set, the management cluster parameter configuration will be inherited.
